name: Fruit Chaat
description: Fresh Pakistani fruit chaat with apple, banana, orange, grapes and guava, gently tossed with citrus and chaat masala.
ingredients: 1 tsp chaat masala, or to taste
method: Wash and dry the fruit. Peel where needed and cut the firmer fruits into similar bite-size pieces.
Prepare the banana and apple close to assembly time because their cut surfaces discolor faster than many other fruits.
Place all the fruit in a large bowl and immediately add the orange or lemon juice, tossing gently to coat the pieces.
Sprinkle over the chaat masala and add sugar only if the fruit itself is not sweet enough.
Fold everything together gently so soft fruit is not crushed and excessive juice is not released.
Chill briefly if desired and serve fresh rather than storing for a long period, as the fruit gradually softens and releases liquid.
